What Documents Do You Need?

Three categories of documents required by the IRS.

Identity Document

  • Valid passport (best option)
  • National ID card with photo
  • Driver's license + Visa

Tax Return or Exception

  • Federal income tax return
  • Exception documentation
  • We help determine which you need

Foreign Status Proof

  • Birth certificate
  • Foreign voter ID
  • Citizenship certificate

IRS Compliance and Processing

What to expect from the IRS after we submit your application.

IRS Processing Time

As of 2026, the IRS processes ITIN applications in 6-11 weeks from the date of receipt. Processing times may be longer during peak tax season (January-April). We submit your application promptly to minimize wait time.

CAA Certification Benefits

Working with an IRS-authorized Certifying Acceptance Agent (CAA) means your identity documents are certified at the source. The IRS trusts CAA-certified copies, so you do not need to mail original documents. This eliminates the risk of loss, damage, or delay in international mail.

Your Money-Back Guarantee

If your ITIN application is rejected due to an error in our preparation or documentation, you receive a 100% refund. This guarantee reflects our confidence in our process. Note: The guarantee covers preparation errors, not IRS discretionary decisions or incomplete information provided by the applicant.

ITIN Application FAQs

Common questions about our ITIN application service.

The process has 5 steps: 1) You complete our online application and upload documents, 2) We review your documents and prepare the W-7 form, 3) An IRS-authorized CAA certifies your documents, 4) We submit your application to the IRS, 5) You receive your ITIN from the IRS in 6-11 weeks. We keep you updated at every step.

You need proof of identity and foreign status. The best document is a valid passport. Alternatives include a national ID card with photo, birth certificate, or driver's license plus visa. You also need a federal tax return or documentation showing you qualify for an exception. We provide a complete checklist after you start your application.

You upload documents through our secure portal. We use bank-level encryption for all file transfers. Our CAA reviews digital copies and certifies them for IRS submission. Your original documents never leave your possession, eliminating the risk of loss or delay in international mail.

Yes. We specialize in helping non-US residents from over 150 countries apply for an ITIN. Our online process and CAA certification mean you can complete the entire application from your home country without traveling to the US or mailing original documents overseas.

You may qualify for an exception that allows you to apply without a tax return. Common exceptions include claiming treaty benefits, being a spouse or dependent of a US citizen or resident, or being a non-resident student. We assess your situation during the application process and advise the best approach.
